claims: As of March 23, 2026, a recall affects nearly 10 million pounds of Trader Joe's Vegetable Fried Rice, Chicken Fried Rice, Japanese Style Fried Rice, and Chicken Shu Mai.
The recall is due to potential contamination with glass fragments.
The affected items were sold in 43 states.
Affected products have best-buy dates ranging between Feb. 28, 2026, and Aug. 19, 2027.
Some reports mention October 2026 for best-buy dates of specific items.
The recall reason is possible presence of foreign objects, specifically hard, clear glass 1–3 cm long from a vegetable ingredient.
Ajinomoto Foods North America Inc. initiated the recall.
The recall is an expansion of earlier safety alerts.
The products were distributed nationwide to 43 states, excluding Hawaii, Maine, New Mexico, South Dakota, Vermont, West Virginia, and Iowa.
